target: Make conport/dope-memory fail-closed on instance identity: reject identity-less write requests instead of proceeding with None.
invariants: Every event stream must have >=1 publisher and >=1 consumer.
Fail-closed on protection/identity; fail-open on advisory/telemetry.

commit.message: fix(memory): fail-closed on instance identity for writes

pr.title: fix(memory): instance-identity fail-closed on writes
pr.body: Governance: conport/dope-memory currently proceed with a None instance id. Require resolved identity on write paths, rejecting identity-less writes (B2).

steps.task: Require resolved instance_id on write paths.
validation: Write paths reject (4xx/raise) when instance_id is absent (instance_detector.py:53 no longer silently proceeds with None).
Test: identity-less write rejected; identity-present write succeeds.
